**Bantam Lake** is the largest natural lake in [Connecticut](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Connecticut "Connecticut"), covering 947 acres (383 ha) in the towns of [Morris](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Morris,_Connecticut "Morris, Connecticut") and [Litchfield](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Litchfield,_Connecticut "Litchfield, Connecticut"). Much of the land at the northern end of the lake, including the peninsula of Marsh Point, is protected by the [White Memorial Foundation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_Memorial_Foundation "White Memorial Foundation") and home to a wide array of bird species.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bantam_Lake#cite_note-5) It is lined by campgrounds,[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bantam_Lake#cite_note-6) camps for kids and has facilities for various water sports.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bantam_Lake#cite_note-:0-7) The lake also has two public beaches, Morris Town Beach[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bantam_Lake#cite_note-8) and Sandy Beach.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bantam_Lake#cite_note-:0-7)
It is home to the Bantam Lake Ski Club,[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bantam_Lake#cite_note-9) the oldest, continuously operating [water ski](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Water_ski "Water ski") club in the United States, as well as the Litchfield Hills Rowing Club[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bantam_Lake#cite_note-10) which offers Summer and Fall (high school) and Masters programs.
